{"attack_type": "dos", "confidence": 0.7, "severity": "high",
 "affected_function": "Unknown - the evidence does not identify the vehicle function affected by the 0x000 injection or the missing IDs 0x0A1/0x2B0",
 "summary": "An ID 0x000, absent from the baseline, injected 3724 frames (709 msg/s over the full alert) with constant zero payloads and near-zero inter-arrival time, consistent with high-priority flooding. Bus load only rose to 1.07x baseline, so arbitration starvation is not proven, but the signature (unknown highest-priority ID, high sustained rate, zero entropy) points to a denial-of-service injection attempt. Several known IDs also show reduced rates and one (0x2B0) went fully missing, which is consistent with bus disruption but could have other causes.",
 "claims": [
  {"text": "0x000 is not in the baseline ID set and sent 3724 frames across the full alert at 709.333 msg/s with payload entropy of -0.000 bits.", "cites": ["E2"]},
  {"text": "0x000 frames carry constant all-zero payloads with mean inter-arrival time of 1.025 ms.", "cites": ["E2", "E10"]},
  {"text": "Peak bus rate was 2088 msg/s versus a 1953 msg/s baseline (1.07x), so total bus load did not substantially increase.", "cites": ["E1"]},
  {"text": "Known ID 0x2B0 was absent in 20 of 20 scored windows despite a 10 ms baseline gap.", "cites": ["E9"]},
  {"text": "Known ID 0x0A1 was absent in 3 of 20 scored windows.", "cites": ["E8"]},
  {"text": "Known IDs 0x1F1, 0x4F0, and 0x5F0 transmitted below baseline rates (0.68x, 0.68x, 0.7x) in the first scored window.", "cites": ["E5", "E6", "E7"]},
  {"text": "The evidence does not identify the vehicle function for 0x000 or the missing IDs.", "cites": ["E2", "E8", "E9"]}
 ],
 "recommended_action": "Isolate or monitor the source of the 0x000 frames (likely an injected node, since 0x000 is absent from baseline), verify whether 0x2B0 and 0x0A1 senders are being starved or suppressed, and confirm bus arbitration impact with an oscilloscope or error-frame counters before remediation."}
message.reasoning: 0x000 unknown ID, 709 msg/s, zero entropy, high priority — classic DoS flooding. Bus load only 1.07x though. Still, sustained injection on 0x000 with constant payload suggests DoS. Confidence moderate.
